title: Hlabs: Mutexo - an UTxO coordination layer

ms.promise:
Initial implementation based on the ouroboros mini-protocols;

comunications with the cardano-node, following the tip of the chain and mempool.
ms.criteria:
The tool:
・succesfully connect to the cardano node,
・follows the tip of the chain
・parses blocks
・follows the evolution of the mempool
ms.report:
A repository has been created here: https://github.com/HarmonicLabs/mutexo-server
The repo implements all the points specified in the acceptance criteria (as well as the code for the following milestone).
A video showcasing the implementation of the points and the tool running is present at this link: https://youtu.be/bztrtgY7XZY

ms.promise: the repository of the previous step will be updated to handle websocket connections from the client and forward the relevant informations
ms.criteria: client interface implementation (requests to lock utxos and responses)
ms.report:
As usual the server repository is here: https://github.com/HarmonicLabs/mutexo-server
the most important file for this milestone is: https://github.com/HarmonicLabs/mutexo-server/blob/main/src/wssWorker/webSocketServer.ts
A video showcasing the server handling the requests of the client is here: https://youtu.be/CZ73srg7EeA

Milestone 1 was strictly about connecting the tool to the node
Milestone 2 was about handling requests coming from the clients, which is a different goal than milestone 1, while in the same repository, I indicated the specific file that has the primary function of handling clients, where instead in milestone 1 the file was another file one entirely, strictly dedicated at handling the connection the node and relative incoming messages (blocks from the chain).

ms.promise:
a separate repository will be setted up under the HLabs organization () likely called `mutexo-client`
the repository implements a library exporting a client class used to interact with the server
ms.criteria:
the client should be able to
・request infos on specific utxos.
・request permission to "lock" utxos and handle possible responses.
・receive updates on utxo being locked or spent.
ms.report:
The client repository is here: https://github.com/HarmonicLabs/mutexo-client
the most important file for this milestone is: https://github.com/HarmonicLabs/mutexo-client/blob/main/src/MutexoClient.ts
A video showcasing the server handling the requests of the client is here: https://youtu.be/PST9MioEzN4

The goal of milestone 3 was strictly to implement the client-side of the protocol, where instead milestones 1 and 2 focused strictly on the server.
For this reason the repository (first link) of milestone 3 is different than the one of milestone 1 and 2, and so is the video (compare the links for verification, or compare the content directly)

ms.promise: yet another repository will be created hosting the documentation of mutexo
ms.criteria: the documentation covers all the functionalities of mutexo, and explains the intended usage both on the client and server side
ms.report: here you can find the documentation for mutexo, both client and server: https://mutexo.harmoniclabs.tech/
